# Cuprice MCP Server

> Public MCP server for integrating Cuprice pricing widgets from AI tools.

## Tools

- [get-pricing](https://docs.cuprice.io/mcp#get-pricing): Get public pricing data (plans, features, theme) by Share ID
- [get-embed-code](https://docs.cuprice.io/mcp#get-embed-code): Get embed snippet for HTML, Next.js, or React
- [get-receipt](https://docs.cuprice.io/mcp#get-receipt): Get Stripe purchase details from a checkout session
- [get-css-classes](https://docs.cuprice.io/mcp#get-css-classes): Get CSS class names for widget customization
